goal: Reduce low-signal noise surfaced by the v4 workspace so attention lands on items that need a decision today. Out of scope: schema changes, schema migrations, AI prompt rewrites (already shipped in commit 1a21ed3b), and empty-content activity update guards (already enforced at api/v4_entities.py:1754 and :3258).
userProblem: Today view and other entity list views render entities with null or placeholder titles as the literal string 'Untitled'. This produces confusing rows that the user cannot act on. Separately, V4Today renders 8 sections of equal weight on first paint: Focus now, Overdue, Due today, Stuck, Projects without open tasks, Stale projects, Suggested archival, Recent notes, plus Delegations quiet and Dependency interventions. With 12 idle projects and 25 recent notes against 3 due-today items, the actionable items are visually buried. Result: high cognitive load, missed follow-ups.
whyNow: User reported too much noise to focus on important work. Diagnostic at /Volumes/lex1t/OC-workspace/memory/engram-cleanup-diagnostic.md identified these two surfaces as the highest-leverage low-risk fixes. Prior commit 1a21ed3b already shipped the extraction-prompt slice. Remaining work is pure presentation.

tasks.title: Drop 'Untitled' fallback strings in MCP and UI
tasks.description: Replace every `entity.title || 'Untitled'` style fallback with explicit rendering that distinguishes a null title from a non-null one. In MCP formatters, render `(no title)` plus the entity id and type when title is missing, so the user has enough info to disambiguate. In React components, do the same and skip the row if title is required by the layout. Total sites: 13 in mcp_server/v4_formatters.py, 5 in ui/src/views/*.jsx. Confirmed by `grep -rn "'Untitled'"` on 2026-06-26.
acceptanceCriteria: When title is null, MCP formatters emit `(no title)` with the entity id and type on the same line
When title is null, React list rows render the entity id and type placeholder instead of the word Untitled
Existing tests in mcp_server/tests/ and ui/src/**/*.test.jsx still pass with updated snapshots where required
cd ui && npm run build passes
validationCommands: cd ui && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build

tasks.title: Default-collapse low-signal sections in V4Today
tasks.description: V4Today currently renders 8 sections on first paint. After this change, the four low-signal sections — Projects without open tasks, Stale projects, Suggested archival, Recent notes — are collapsed by default and reveal via a 'Show N more' disclosure. The remaining four — Focus now, Overdue, Due today/follow-up, Stuck — remain visible at top. Cap the Projects without open tasks list at 5 visible items (with 'View all 12' link if more exist). Recent notes stays in the same screen but is collapsed, not removed. This is presentation only — the underlying `/api/v4/today` payload is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: On first render of V4Today with mixed-state data, Projects without open tasks / Stale projects / Suggested archival / Recent notes are collapsed

keyDecisions: Already-shipped work (commit 1a21ed3b) handles the extraction-prompt concerns. Do not re-touch.
Empty-content activity update guard already exists at api/v4_entities.py:1754 and :3258. Do not re-touch.
Render null titles as '(no title) [type-id]' instead of empty string so user retains disambiguation context.
Cap idle projects at 5 visible, do not remove the section — user may still want to scan it.
Keep Recent notes collapsed in place rather than relocating to Inbox (out of scope per non-goals).
mainRisks: Existing test snapshots that include the word Untitled will need updating
Removing 'Untitled' fallback could expose bugs where entity rendering assumed title was always non-null
V4Today collapse logic must remain keyboard-accessible (focusable disclosure controls)
continuityNote.nextStepIfInterrupted: The two tasks are independent. Either task can land on its own branch. Do not block on the regression test — it can ride with the formatters task.
